Are you buying what you want, or what impresses others?

Kevin Trudeau says many people have a syndrome called keeping up with the Joneses, and his answer is delayed gratification.

His idea: choose a much less expensive home than the one you were considering. Over a few years you build savings, and when you sell, you may be able to put much more down or buy in full.

He says that is how you start.

What would you do differently if nobody was watching?
